review.review: The living hero exhausted mandatory potion discovery, not combat: decision 352 (log line 947) stopped at 25/25 HP after decision 351 advanced the clock to turn 351 (accepted line 945). The initiating contradiction is that exploration can leave the admitted preparation-return graph before discovery is allowed to start. Decisions 349–351 move from water 802 through grass 759 and 716 to floor 673 (selection lines 938, 941, 944). At the terminal position, every historical bank return is disconnected by excluded grass 716/759. Source-pinned offline bookkeeping reconstruction matched all 352 recorded actions and reasons, decisions 0–351, and reproduced the terminal blocker. This is reconstructed state, not recorded memory. Seven reconstructed bank receipts cover the exact current indigo-plus-liquid-flame inventory; nearby banks 931, 845 and 888 therefore fail transit, not inventory matching or the distance bound. The selecting chain is tools/mage_policy.py:358–495, tools/descent_potions.py:266–294,403–452,103–149. Return transit excludes grass; fresh bank checks also require visible safe surroundings and inventory protection. Both return and reconnaissance prerequisites decline. The terminal inventory has no known mapping or clairvoyance resource; indigo remains unidentified. No policy or regression patch is supplied. Complete source and reconstruction resolve the packet's bookkeeping gap, but not the safety of an early preparation transaction. Broadening grass admission would weaken the existing safety filter; starting discovery earlier would bypass the deliberate pre-descent conservation/progression contract unless unfinished exploration and collection are retained and resumed. The concrete next repair is a bounded preparation reservation before the second grass step, tested with paired decisions 350/351, actual accepted transit/drop/effect/retrieval receipts, fresh arrival checks and restoration of the unfinished frontier objective. An isolated return proposal alone would not establish safe discovery or puzzle completion.
review.learnings: Exploration and mandatory discovery must share a preparation reservation: a remembered safe bank is insufficient once exploration disconnects every admitted return. Preserve unknown identities, potion protection, fresh arrival checks and all unfinished pickup obligations; do not solve this by allowing grass or restoring idle waits.
